$comment: Predefined dispatchable tasks - one-action dispatch via `nim.agency dispatch --preset <slug>` or the Type Foundry. `skill` seeds crew matching; `count` is the default crew size.

data.label: Inventory TODOs
data.description: Sweep the target for deferred work markers
data.prompt: Inventory all TODO, FIXME, HACK, and XXX comments in the target directory. For each: file path, line, marker type, and the comment text. Group by file and finish with counts per marker type.

data.label: Documentation Coverage
data.description: Assess README/inline docs against the code that exists
data.prompt: Assess documentation coverage in the target directory: README completeness, per-module docstrings/comments, setup instructions, and undocumented public surfaces. Cite files. Finish with the three highest-value gaps.

data.label: Code Assimilation
data.description: The metamorphic assimilating transformer: audit a module against STYLE.md for redundancy, overloads, style drift, and hardcoded data
data.prompt: NIM CODE ASSIMILATION PROTOCOL - read-only analysis pass. Target: the module/subsystem named in the operator's instructions (or the largest module under the working directory if unnamed). Read STYLE.md first; it is the alignment target. Produce a prioritized, mechanically-executable refactor plan with exact line numbers: (1) REDUNDANCY - near-duplicate methods/blocks to consolidate, each with a proposed generalized signature; (2) OVERLOADS - local reimplementations of centralized helpers (compare against lib/config, lib/data, lib/dispatch, tui/textkit) to delete in favor of the canonical one; (3) STYLE - violations of STYLE.md conventions and prohibited practices, including dead code and advertised-but-unbound controls; (4) DATA-LAYER - heredocs and hardcoded static data to relocate into data/ files loaded at runtime, with a proposed home for each; (5) STRUCTURE - if the module exceeds ~1000 lines, split boundaries as mixins over shared state, safest-first move-only extraction order with line ranges and a risk list. Modify nothing. Finish with the top five highest-value moves.

data.label: Secrets Sweep
data.description: Hunt for credentials that should not be on disk
data.prompt: Sweep the target directory for hardcoded credentials, API keys, tokens, private keys, and suspicious .env or config values. Check .gitignore coverage for sensitive paths. Report findings with file and line; state clearly if nothing was found.
